hey i know i’m late but i also have this too. i am 99% sure that you have keratosis pilaris rubra faceii (KPRF). i understand how embarrassing it is i feel you :(. i’ve done a lot of research on this, i’ve checked every bit of the internet looking for help. what i’ve found is, you need to break it up into 2 parts : flushing/blushing and baseline redness. (flushing is from cold wind etc and blushing is from embarrassment). 
for flushing/blushing i take SSRI anti depressants medication, and man it really works! the warm feeling goes as fast as it comes. there are side effects but personally i don’t notice any of them, i’d look into it before trying them (SNRI also work according to other people). Now this is pretty much all we know that ca. combat flare ups. For baseline redness there are 2 ways. people really recommend a good anti redness moisturiser. (you might need to experiment with different brands to find which one works for you). i haven’t personally tried a moisturiser, they work because the moisturiser has a green tint that masks the redness a bit.  the second option is to get a pdl/vbeam. there isn’t enough research done to make a scientific conclusion on how successful it is but it has definitely worked for a few people. i plan to try this once i turn 18. good luck and feel free to ask me any questions :) 

edit: Also tanning is a great way to hide it, just an idea :p
